elements.requirement: The landlord's implied covenant to cooperate includes providing any information, including names and contact details of residents and tenants of the premises, to a relevant person or their written authorised representative where the information is reasonably required in connection with the relevant person complying with their building safety duties.

elements.quote: carrying out works to the premises, where such works are required to be carried out in connection with a relevant person complying with their building safety duties

elements.requirement: A relevant building safety purpose includes accessing a part of the higher-risk building that is not let to the tenant in order to inspect that part of the building in connection with a relevant person complying with their building safety duties.

elements.requirement: When determining whether a disclosure of information would contravene the data protection legislation, the duty imposed by subsections (2)(b) and (4)(b) must be taken into account.
